name: dealer-ai-visibility
description: Monitor what AI engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Google AI Mode) are actually saying about a car dealership. Runs a 25-30 query taxonomy with bilingual variants, extracts citations, buckets cited sources by type (OEM, third-party listings, reviews, forums, local press, dealer-owned), computes citation share against competitors, and produces a quarterly report plus optional Word doc and live HTML dashboard. Two modes: manual paste (universal) and agent-driven (with Ahrefs Brand Radar MCP or web tools). Branded as Dealer AI Visibility at dealeraivisibility.com from Dealer Growth Hackers. Distinct from dealer-aeo-audit: the audit finds the gaps; this skill measures the live citation result and competitive share.
